question: What Are the Types of Thermocouples and Their Ranges?
body_html:
Thermocouple types are identified by letters, each with its own metal pair and temperature range:

TypeRange
K−200 to 1260 °C
J (iron, constantan)−40 to 750 °C
T (copper, constantan)−200 to 350 °C
E (chromel, constantan)−200 to 900 °C
N (nicrosil, nisil)−200 to 1300 °C
S / R / B (platinum, rhodium)0 to 1480 / 1600 / 1700 °C

Type K is the most common, Type T suits sub zero work and Type B handles the highest temperature.
